EditSavedWorkflow.note: Full editor in edit mode: page shell header with Cancel/Save, title + default-repository selects, description, the inputs editor with two typed rows, backed by a real agent catalog so the harness/model/effort selects populate.

CreateWorkflow.note: Create mode — 'New workflow' title, Create action, placeholder copy, empty inputs list and the seeded Stage 1.

ValidationIssues.note: Issue summary banner plus the per-field 'Title is required.' message and the aria-invalid input treatment.

ServerError.note: Destructive server-error banner with its inline Reload action. NOTE: the catalogWarning branch is deliberately not previewed — the editor paints it as text-warning and this dark theme's --color-warning is a 15% alpha FILL, so that band photographs blank (a DS token bug, recorded in learnings/I.md).
